title: Ukraine’s Winter of Pressure – European Council on Foreign Relations
gist: ECFR podcast blurb: Ukraine enters another wartime winter with Russia intensifying strikes on cities and energy networks while Kyiv faces air-defence interceptor shortages, political infighting, corruption probes and economic strain, alongside escalating Russian hybrid attacks across Europe.

insights.claim: Despite Ukraine's success in disrupting Russian logistics and energy infrastructure, Russia has intensified attacks on Ukrainian cities, energy networks and civilian targets heading into the 2026-27 winter.
insights.speaker: Jana Kobzová, Mark Leonard
insights.so_what: Watch Ukrainian grid damage and winter power/gas import needs as a driver of European energy-aid flows and regional power prices.
insights.locator: This week, Mark Leonard is joined

insights.claim: Shortages of air-defence interceptors, political infighting, corruption investigations and economic challenges are converging on Kyiv at a particularly difficult moment.
insights.speaker: Jana Kobzová, Mark Leonard
insights.so_what: Interceptor scarcity is a demand signal for European air-defence producers; domestic political strain raises tail risk for Ukraine's war-financing credibility.
insights.quote: shortages of air-defence interceptors, political infighting, corruption investigations and economic challenges are converging at a particularly difficult moment for Ukraine
insights.locator: Jana explains how shortages of air-defence

insights.claim: Russia is escalating hybrid attacks across Europe, making resilience-building by Europeans and support for Ukraine's defences linked priorities.
insights.speaker: Jana Kobzová, Mark Leonard
insights.so_what: Supports sustained European spending on critical-infrastructure security, cyber and air defence.
insights.locator: Jana explains how shortages of air-defence

insights.claim: The open question framed by ECFR is whether Ukraine and its allies can maintain unity as Russia raises pressure on and off the battlefield, with the future of European support and Ukraine's role in Europe's long-term security architecture at stake.
insights.speaker: Jana Kobzová, Mark Leonard
insights.so_what: Allied cohesion over the winter is the key variable for European defence budgets and any ceasefire-pricing in Ukrainian/regional assets.
insights.quote: can Ukraine and its allies maintain the unity needed to hold the line?
